name: Instruction
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of instruction as a means of passing down the mighty works and deliverance of the LORD to future generations, as seen in the repeated commands to tell children about God's acts in Egypt and the significance of the Passover (Exodus 10:2; 12:26-27; 13:8,14). This instruction is not merely historical recounting but serves to remind and teach the people of God's faithfulness and power, ensuring that obedience and worship arise from understanding God's redemptive acts (Exodus 13:11). Through these teachings, the LORD establishes a foundation for continual remembrance and reverence among His people.
